title: The Inaugural Patch
summary: This is the very first version of the patch notes, setting up the new system and introducing some initial changes. More to come!

changes.name: Patch Notes System
changes.description: The website now has a dedicated page for patch notes! This will serve as a changelog for all future updates, big and small. I've definitely missed the first 2 years of patches but it starts now.

title: The First Update
summary: This is the first update to the patch notes, setting up the new system and introducing some initial changes. More to come!

changes.name: Book bar
changes.description: The book bar is now a thing in the playground! It's a simple bar that displays the books I'm reading and the progress I've made on them. It's a work in progress and will be updated as I read more books. I'm using the Google Books API to fetch the books and the progress is tracked in the browser's local storage.

title: TFT Match History Update
summary: I've now added some more content to the TFT page, including win/losses and placement data. I ran into some issues with rate limiting so I tried adding caching and rate limiting to the worker. However this limits the worker to only seeing up to 7 matches at a time so I'm not sure if it's worth it.

changes.name: TFT Match History
changes.description: TFT match history now works!

title: Major Strava Integration Update
summary: Complete real-time Strava integration added to the playground! This major update brings comprehensive activity tracking with webhooks, monthly organization, heart rate monitoring, and beautiful visual design. One of the biggest feature additions to the site so far.

changes.name: Strava Activities Integration
changes.description: Complete Strava API integration with real-time webhook updates. Activities are automatically synced when uploaded to Strava and organized by month and year for easy browsing.

changes.name: Monthly Activity Dashboard
changes.description: Current month stats dashboard showing activities completed, distance covered, time in motion, average heart rate, and max heart rate. Automatically updates each month and provides motivational fitness insights.

changes.name: Activity Color Coding
changes.description: Different activity types now have distinct colors - red for runs, blue for rides, teal for swims, green for hikes, purple for workouts, and more. Makes it easy to identify activity types at a glance.

changes.name: Heart Rate Analytics
changes.description: Both average and max heart rate are displayed for individual activities and calculated for monthly summaries. Provides insights into training intensity and cardiovascular effort.

changes.name: Cloudflare Workers Backend
changes.description: Serverless backend using Cloudflare Workers with KV storage for efficient data management. Includes webhook handling, token refresh automation, and smart caching to respect Strava's rate limits.

changes.name: Playground Layout Reorganization
changes.description: Moved Strava to the first position in the playground grid and added proper Strava branding image. Updated the flow to prioritize fitness tracking.

changes.name: Monthly Activity Cards
changes.description: Interactive monthly cards that expand to show detailed activities when clicked. Each month displays summary statistics including activity count, total distance, and time.

changes.name: Responsive Stats Grid
changes.description: 5-card stats grid that adapts to different screen sizes, showing current month's key fitness metrics with clear labels and engaging copy.

changes.name: Real-time Webhook System
changes.description: Strava webhooks automatically update activity data in real-time when activities are uploaded, edited, or deleted. No need to wait for daily syncs.

changes.name: Weekly Backup Sync
changes.description: Automated weekly sync fetches comprehensive activity data from the last 2 years and organizes it by month. Ensures no activities are missed and provides data redundancy.

changes.name: Smart Data Organization
changes.description: Activities are automatically organized by month and year with efficient KV storage. Each month is stored separately for fast loading and scalable data management.

changes.name: Footer Date Update
changes.description: Updated footer to show 'Sept 2025' to reflect current month.

title: Strava Activity Links & Twitter Integration
summary: Quick quality-of-life improvements to enhance user experience with clickable activity links and Twitter/X social integration.

changes.name: Clickable Activity Links
changes.description: All Strava activity names are now clickable links that open the full activity page on Strava in a new tab. Added external link icons for clear visual indication of clickability.

changes.name: Twitter/X Social Integration
changes.description: Added Twitter/X (@ujustgotleid) to both footer social icons and contact dialog with classic Twitter bird icon for better recognition.

changes.name: Contact Dialog Enhancement
changes.description: Updated LinkedIn contact entry to show handle 'leiwuhoo' instead of generic 'LinkedIn' text for more personalized experience.

changes.name: Recipes Page Footer Fix
changes.description: Fixed duplicate footer appearing on recipes and eats page by removing redundant footer rendering from Food.js component.

changes.name: Home Page Tile Alignment
changes.description: Fixed text alignment inconsistency on design portfolio tile to match other homepage tiles.

title: MCP Integration & Resume Update
summary: Added a new playground page for the Poke MCP Server project, updated resume with latest experience, and implemented lowercase styling consistency across the Strava integration.

changes.name: Poke MCP Server Page
changes.description: Added a new playground tile and page for the Poke MCP Server project. The page provides information about the Twitter metrics and automated reminders MCP server, then redirects to the GitHub repository. Features auto-redirect after 3 seconds with manual override option.

changes.name: Resume Update
changes.description: Updated resume with latest professional experience, skills, and achievements. The resume reflects current expertise and career progression.

changes.name: Lowercase Month Styling
changes.description: Updated all month names throughout the Strava page to display in lowercase for consistent styling. This includes current month headings, month cards, activity section headers, and individual activity dates.

changes.name: Playground Grid Layout
changes.description: Expanded playground grid layout to accommodate 6 tiles instead of 5, maintaining responsive design for both desktop and mobile viewing.

changes.name: Poke Page Styling
changes.description: Implemented lowercase text styling for the new Poke MCP Server page to maintain consistency with the overall site design aesthetic.

changes.name: Route Configuration
changes.description: Added proper React Router configuration for the new /playground/poke route with lazy loading and suspense handling for optimal performance.

changes.name: Component Architecture
changes.description: Created modular Poke.js component following established patterns from other playground pages, including PlayNav integration and consistent styling.

title: Major Codebase Refactoring & Organization
summary: Complete codebase overhaul with comprehensive refactoring, performance improvements, accessibility enhancements, and backend organization. This major version bump reflects significant architectural improvements that make the codebase more maintainable, performant, and accessible while organizing all playground backend services.

changes.name: Shared Styled Components System
changes.description: Created comprehensive SharedStyledComponents.js with centralized design tokens, common layouts, typography, and UI components. Eliminated ~200 lines of duplicate styled-component code across the application.

changes.name: Navigation Pattern Modernization
changes.description: Replaced all window.location.href calls with React Router's useNavigate() hook for proper client-side navigation. Improves performance by eliminating unnecessary page reloads.

changes.name: Component Prop Validation
changes.description: Added comprehensive PropTypes validation to components for better development experience and runtime error prevention.

changes.name: Utility Functions Organization
changes.description: Created utils/formatters.js with reusable formatting functions, API endpoints, and utility helpers. Eliminates duplicate functions across playground components.

changes.name: Proper Alt Text Implementation
changes.description: Added descriptive alt attributes to all images throughout the application. Improved screen reader compatibility and semantic meaning.

changes.name: ARIA Labels and Semantic HTML
changes.description: Enhanced components with proper ARIA labels, aria-hidden attributes, and semantic HTML structure for better accessibility.

changes.name: Keyboard Navigation Support
changes.description: Improved focus management with proper focus indicators and keyboard-accessible button implementations.

changes.name: Screen Reader Utilities
changes.description: Added screen reader-only utility classes for enhanced accessibility without visual impact.

changes.name: CSS Custom Properties
changes.description: Implemented CSS variables for consistent theming across colors, fonts, breakpoints, and shadows. Enables easier maintenance and future theming.

changes.name: Font Declaration Unification
changes.description: Standardized font declarations between CSS and styled-components for consistency. Improved font loading with font-display: swap.

changes.name: Enhanced CSS Reset
changes.description: Improved CSS reset with box-sizing inheritance, font smoothing, and better base styles for cross-browser consistency.

changes.name: Unused Image Cleanup
changes.description: Removed 9 unused image files saving ~18MB (33% reduction) in bundle size. Kept optimized versions and eliminated large originals.

changes.name: Import Organization
changes.description: Organized imports logically (React, third-party, local components, assets) and removed all unused imports across the codebase.

changes.name: Component Code Deduplication
changes.description: Eliminated duplicate styled components and consolidated common patterns into reusable components.

changes.name: Playground Backend Structure
changes.description: Created comprehensive playground-backend/ directory with organized subdirectories: apis/ (Python Spotify API), workers/ (Cloudflare Workers), demos/ (development apps), and docs/ (setup guides).

changes.name: Documentation Enhancement
changes.description: Added comprehensive README files for the main repository, frontend project, and backend services with clear setup instructions and architecture explanations.

changes.name: File Path Updates
changes.description: Updated all documentation references to reflect the new organized file structure while maintaining backward compatibility for deployed services.

changes.name: Error Boundary Implementation
changes.description: Created comprehensive ErrorBoundary component with development error details, user-friendly fallbacks, and recovery options.

changes.name: Loading State Unification
changes.description: Standardized loading components and patterns across all async operations for consistent user experience.

changes.name: Lint Error Resolution
changes.description: Resolved all ESLint errors and warnings across the entire codebase for clean, maintainable code.

changes.name: Playground Navigation Consistency
changes.description: Fixed playground main page navigation to match About and Projects pages. Now properly returns to home page with TopNav instead of internal playground navigation.

changes.name: Duplicate Navigation Removal
changes.description: Eliminated duplicate back buttons in playground by removing redundant TopNav/PlayNav components from individual playground pages.

changes.name: External Link Security
changes.description: Improved external link handling with proper window.open() usage and security attributes (noopener, noreferrer).

changes.name: Bundle Size Reduction
changes.description: Achieved ~18MB reduction in asset size through unused image removal and code deduplication.

changes.name: Code Maintainability
changes.description: Centralized styling and components make future updates significantly easier with consistent patterns.

changes.name: Performance Enhancement
changes.description: Faster navigation through proper React Router usage and reduced bundle size for better loading times.

changes.name: Developer Experience
changes.description: Better error handling, organized file structure, and comprehensive documentation improve development workflow.

title: TypeScript Migration!
summary: Captured the TypeScript migration commit alongside the JavaScript cleanup, Tailwind tweaks, and Jest smoke-test fix so the repo history and patch notes stay in sync.

changes.name: Legacy JavaScript Removal
changes.description: Deleted redundant .js files across pages, components, utilities, and scripts now backed by TypeScript implementations to keep the codebase consistent and prevent drift.

changes.name: TypeScript Migration Commit
changes.description: Captured the `afa119a` TypeScript migration work in this patch so the notes reflect the underlying repo history that triggered the cleanup.

changes.name: Tailwind Content Scope
changes.description: Restricted Tailwind's content glob to only .ts and .tsx sources so the JIT pipeline no longer scans removed JavaScript files.

changes.name: App Styles Cleanup
changes.description: Removed stale App.css imports from Home, About, Playground, and 404 pages after consolidating styling into styled-components, eliminating missing stylesheet errors.

changes.name: App Test Import Fix
changes.description: Restored the App import in App.test.tsx so the render smoke test executes without ReferenceError after the file cleanup.
